versions.changelog:
Initial release: Alicloud CMS Dataset lifecycle management and querying.

- Supports listing, inspecting, creating, updating, deleting CMS datasets, and executing dataset queries via the aliyun CLI (CMS API v2024-03-30).
- Enforces explicit AI-mode enable/disable and Alibaba Cloud credential pre-check.
- Requires parameter confirmation for all user inputs and validates naming rules for datasets/fields.
- Handles workspace existence, creation, and strict product binding (cms only).
- Safe command execution: checks existence before create/update, enforces schema and permission checks, and manages required RAM policies.
- Includes detailed instructions on installation, authentication, and core workflows.
